text.title: Field Infirmary
text.body: Deep inside an ironwood glade, Chief Healer Sera tends dozens of burned and broken refugees—including familiar survivors from Thornwick such as Reeve Marlow and Father Cael—beneath canvas pavilions. Hold a 360-degree shield wall, repel three converging raider warbands, and keep Sera alive.
text.obj.0: Repel all three raider warbands attacking the glade
text.msg.1: If I take one step back, these people bleed out in the mud—even Reeve Marlow and Father Cael barely dragged themselves here from Thornwick. Hold the line, commander—I will not leave them!
text.msg.2: First wave! Wolf-riders and dual-blade skirmishers race down the muddy northern wagon ruts!
text.msg.3: Second wave! Poison-arrow snipers and rogue hexers burst out of the western pines!
text.msg.4: Final wave from the east—a heavy shock battalion spearheaded by a towering Stone Golem!
text.msg.5: All three warbands broke against your shield wall! Every stretcher—and our Thornwick survivors—will reach Harborwatch intact.
text.win: Every warband shattered outside the tents, and Sera's wounded reached Harborwatch intact.
text.fail.1: Your hero fell defending the field infirmary.
text.fail.2: Chief Healer Sera was slain and the field infirmary fell.
